lines: What if every scroll stole double the time?
One minute. Then two. Then four. Then eight.
By sunrise? Eight hours. Your bio chapter? Still unread.
By the test? A whole week. Gone.
Snap the chapter, and BOOM! It turns into TikToks.
Short TikToks, made from YOUR chapter.
Now every scroll teaches you something.
Don't put it down. Make it count.
Try it free. unspool dot c c.
